events.title: SK hynix, Sandisk set first HBF standard for AI memory
events.summary: SK hynix and Sandisk have established the first industry standard for High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) memory, aiming to bridge the performance and capacity gap between high bandwidth memory (HBM) and solid-state drives (SSDs) for AI applications. The companies also plan to introduce their tenth-generation, 375-layer 4D NAND technology to begin mass production of high-performance enterprise SSDs next year, targeting power-intensive AI data centers.

events.title: Scholar Rock Eyes Sept. 30 FDA Decision for SMA Drug Apitegromab
events.summary: Scholar Rock is anticipating a September 30 FDA decision for its investigational spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) drug, apitegromab. Scholar Rock is also exploring the drug's potential for facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD) and building commercial capabilities for a potential U.S. launch.

events.title: $3.4 Billion Rail Cash Buffer Eases Tutor Perini Funding Concerns

events.title: Vuzix ships optical interconnect samples for AI data centers By Investing.com
events.summary: Vuzix Corporation has started shipping Causeway waveguide bridge samples for AI data center optical interconnect applications. The company is providing an evaluation kit that supports up to 19,200 parallel optical channels and is also developing waveguide samples for VCSEL sources. This initiative leverages Vuzix's existing expertise in manufacturing diffractive waveguides for smart glasses to tap into the rapidly growing co-packaged and near-package optics market for data centers, which is projected to reach over $39 billion by 2030.

events.title: Before costly factory experiments, Silvaco and Dassault Systèmes plan digital twins
events.summary: Silvaco and Dassault Systèmes have partnered to develop interoperable digital twin workflows for semiconductor manufacturing. This collaboration aims to connect equipment-scale plasma simulation, feature-scale process modeling, and structural analysis to help chip makers understand how equipment conditions affect wafer-level and structural outcomes. The goal is to advance first-time-right semiconductor process development, reduce manual data handoffs, and improve traceability across manufacturing stages, ultimately leading to faster and more confident production of new semiconductor technologies.

events.title: Western Digital Erased Its Earnings Crash. Its New 10-K Names the Risk the Rally Ignored
events.summary: Western Digital's stock has recovered significantly after an earnings crash, but its recent 10-K filing reveals two major risks: high customer concentration (89% cloud revenue, 73% from top ten customers) and potential share dilution from convertible notes. While the demand for AI storage is strong and long-term agreements are in place, the pricing for future years is still under negotiation, and the company lags its main competitor, Seagate, in technology. events.title: What Applied Materials (AMAT)'s Record Q3 Results and UC Berkeley AI Push Mean For Shareholders

events.title: Defiance Launches AINF: An ETF Dedicated to AI Inference Chips

events.title: KLA Stock: Covered Call Strategy Could Generate 21% Annualized Income

events.summary: KLA Corporation is positioned to outgrow the broader chip equipment market through 2030, driven by increasing demand for process control in advanced semiconductor manufacturing, especially due to AI. KLA's focus on inspection, metrology, and yield optimization provides a direct link to the growing need for defect control and manufacturing precision in the increasingly complex chip industry.

events.title: Bitmine Immersion Technologies Stock Surges as Aggressive Ethereum Treasury Accumulation and Staking Rewards Fuel Momentum
events.summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) stock rallied due to a surge in crypto prices, aggressive Ethereum treasury accumulation, and staking rewards. events.title: STMicroelectronics, National University of Singapore Launch Edge AI Research Lab
events.summary: STMicroelectronics and the National University of Singapore have partnered to launch a corporate lab dedicated to advancing Edge AI technology in Singapore. This collaboration aims to foster innovation in artificial intelligence directly at the device level. The initiative underscores both entities' commitment to developing cutting-edge solutions for future technological challenges.

events.title: Applied Materials stock holds below record highs as fresh guidance and AI demand support the outlook
events.summary: Applied Materials Inc. stock is trading below its 52-week high despite record fiscal third-quarter results and strong fourth-quarter guidance driven by AI-related chip equipment demand. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with a target price well above the current stock price, reflecting confidence in the ongoing AI-driven demand for advanced semiconductor tools.

events.title: Gartner Forecasts Worldwide Semiconductor Revenue to Reach $1.6 Trillion in 2026
events.summary: Gartner forecasts worldwide semiconductor revenue to reach $1.6 trillion in 2026, a 92% increase from 2025, driven largely by sustained investment in AI infrastructure and a strong memory pricing cycle. The AI data center ecosystem is expected to significantly increase its share of semiconductor revenue, highlighting a structural shift in demand. Memory revenue, particularly DRAM and NAND flash, will be a primary contributor to this growth, supported by rising AI infrastructure deployments and increased memory content per AI server.

Rebellions, which specializes in neural processing units for data centers, has raised significant funding from investors like Samsung Ventures and SK Hynix, and the South Korean government, indicating its strategic importance.

events.title: Gartner Forecasts Worldwide Semiconductor Revenue to Reach $1.6 Trillion in 2026
events.summary: Gartner forecasts worldwide semiconductor revenue to reach $1.6 trillion in 2026, a 92% increase from $809 billion in 2025, primarily driven by investments in AI infrastructure and a strong memory pricing cycle. events.summary: Xiaomi has launched its new Xring O3 mobile processor, developed in-house to reduce reliance on Qualcomm and MediaTek. The 3-nanometer chip aims to offer more power-efficient image processing and better AI capabilities for Xiaomi's flagship devices. events.title: KLA (KLAC) Gains From Advanced Nodes, HBM and Packaging

events.title: Unbreakable Shield: Why Taiwan’s Chip Expertise Cannot Be Cloned
events.summary: Taiwan's semiconductor industry is a complex ecosystem, far beyond just wafer foundries, encompassing advanced packaging, materials, and a dense network of suppliers and talent. While Taiwan is building new semiconductor plants in the US, Japan, and Europe, this diversification alone will not eliminate global reliance on the island. The article argues that instead of trying to replace Taiwan, the US and Europe should focus on reinforcing Taiwan's resilience and role as a core pillar of the democratic semiconductor alliance by supporting its advancements and aligning industrial policies.

events.title: Applied Materials Inc Stock (AMAT) Opened Down by 3.02% on Aug 24: What Investors Need To Know
events.summary: Applied Materials Inc (AMAT) stock opened down by 3.02% despite reporting record quarterly earnings driven by strong AI infrastructure demand. events.title: Canada and Japan back a quantum project aimed at reducing blur in powerful chips
events.summary: Xanadu and Mitsubishi Chemical are collaborating on a quantum computing project to improve extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography, a crucial process in semiconductor fabrication. This initiative, supported by Canadian and Japanese government programs, aims to reduce radiation-induced blurring in chip manufacturing by developing a fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC)-ready software pipeline. The project builds on previous work where quantum algorithms modeled optical properties of EUV photoresists and seeks to create a blueprint for quantum-driven materials discovery while strengthening Canada-Japan research ties.

events.title: Xanadu and Mitsubishi Chemical Advance Quantum Computing Work on EUV Lithography
events.summary: Xanadu and Mitsubishi Chemical are expanding their collaboration to develop quantum computing methods for improving EUV lithography and semiconductor materials. This second phase will integrate parameters from Xanadu’s quantum simulations into Mitsubishi Chemical’s multi-scale models to study radiation-induced blur in EUV lithography. The project, supported by Canadian and Japanese innovation programs, aims to create a fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC)-ready software workflow to identify materials that prevent blurring in semiconductor manufacturing.

events.title: Nouri joins Applied Materials as global head of ventures
events.summary: Faran Nouri has been appointed global head of Applied Ventures, the corporate VC arm of US semiconductor company Applied Materials. Nouri will lead the firm’s investment strategy and portfolio, focusing on technologies that accelerate innovation in the semiconductor industry and broader deep tech ecosystem. Her return to Applied Materials comes after significant experience in US national semiconductor investment policy at Natcast and America's Frontier Fund, and previously as a vice-president at Lam Capital.

events.title: Xanadu and Mitsubishi Chemical begin next phase of quantum semiconductor research collaboration
events.summary: Xanadu Quantum Technologies and Mitsubishi Chemical are advancing their collaboration to use quantum computing for semiconductor fabrication, specifically in simulating extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography. This next phase, supported by Canadian and Japanese government funding, aims to create a production-ready software pipeline that integrates quantum simulations into Mitsubishi's models to prevent blurring and identify optimal materials for semiconductor manufacturing. The partnership seeks to overcome a critical bottleneck in next-generation semiconductor technology and secure a competitive advantage.

events.title: Lancium Adds NVIDIA as Investor and Partner, Targeting Gigawatt AI Factories Across a 15GW Pipeline
events.summary: Lancium has announced a strategic collaboration and investment from NVIDIA to develop large-scale accelerated computing infrastructure for AI factories. events.summary: This article compares two semiconductor stocks, Lam Research (LRCX) and Microchip Technology (MCHP), to determine which is a better investment. (NASDAQ:NTAP), purchasing over 1.67 million shares valued at approximately $258.1 million, giving it a 0.85% ownership. NetApp's recent quarterly revenue exceeded estimates, but EPS fell short, and analysts currently maintain a consensus "Hold" rating with a price target of $179.77.

events.title: Jared Moskowitz Buys Applied Materials Stock and Sells STERIS and W.W. Grainger Shares
events.summary: Representative Jared Moskowitz of Florida's 23rd congressional district recently bought stock in Applied Materials Inc. for $1,001 to $15,000, while selling shares of STERIS plc and W.W. Grainger, Inc. within the same value range. Applied Materials has seen significant gains, though InvestingPro analysis suggests it may be overvalued. These transactions were disclosed via his Morgan Stanley Active Assets account as required by the STOCK Act.

events.title: SK hynix breaks ground on $4 billion advanced packaging production facility in Purdue Research Park
events.summary: SK hynix has broken ground on its first U.S. high bandwidth memory production hub in Purdue Research Park, a $4 billion advanced packaging fabrication and R&D facility for AI memory. This investment is driven by Purdue University's innovation and talent development, with Purdue leading U.S. semiconductor reshoring efforts through its Semiconductor Degrees Program. The project is expected to create approximately 1,000 jobs and foster significant economic development and research collaboration in the advanced packaging field.

events.title: SK hynix Holds Groundbreaking Ceremony for HBM Production Base in Indiana, “Beginning a New Future for US-Korea AI”
events.summary: SK hynix is investing over $4 billion to establish its first HBM production base in the U.S., located in Indiana, with mass production slated for the second half of 2029. This initiative aims to stabilize the U.S. semiconductor supply chain, create approximately 7,000 jobs, and foster strong economic cooperation between the U.S. and South Korea, including an R&D partnership with Purdue University and a veteran recruitment program. The facility will combine advanced packaging of wafers from Korea with a new "Made in USA" approach for AI memory products.

events.title: Applied Materials Inc. stock underperforms Friday when compared to competitors
events.summary: Shares of Applied Materials Inc. fell by 4.29% to $461.67 on Friday, significantly underperforming the broader market as both the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average also declined. The company's stock closed 37.58% below its 52-week high.

events.title: Applied Materials Appoints Akash Palkhiwala to Board of Directors
events.summary: Applied Materials, Inc. has announced the appointment of Akash Palkhiwala, Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer of Qualcomm Incorporated, to its board of directors. Mr. Palkhiwala will also serve on the board's Audit Committee. His extensive financial and operational leadership experience in the technology industry, particularly semiconductors, is expected to strengthen Applied Materials' board during its next phase of growth.

events.title: KLA Corp. Stock Slides 4.5%, Underperforms Peers
events.summary: KLA Corp. (KLAC) stock fell by 4.5% to $175.54, underperforming the broader market as the Dow Jones Industrial Average remained flat and the S&P 500 Index declined. This marks the second consecutive day of losses for KLA Corp., with its stock now 42.9% below its 52-week high. Peers like Applied Materials Inc., Analog Devices Inc., and Marvell Technology Inc. also experienced declines, though KLA's performance was mixed in comparison.

events.title: Diodes Completes Acquisition of ElevATE Semiconductor, Expanding Presence in High-Growth ATE Market
events.summary: Diodes Incorporated (Nasdaq: DIOD) has successfully acquired ElevATE Semiconductor, Inc., a leading provider of high-performance integrated circuits for the Automated Test Equipment (ATE) market, in an all-cash transaction for $250 million. This acquisition is expected to expand Diodes' analog and mixed-signal product portfolio and strengthen its position in high-growth end markets, anticipating approximately $50 million in revenue and immediate accretion to Diodes' revenue, gross margin, and earnings per share in the first twelve months. ElevATE will operate as a product line within Diodes, leveraging Diodes' global infrastructure and manufacturing scale.

events.title: Applied Materials Inc (AMAT) Stock Down 4.3% but Still Overvalued -- GF Score: 85/100
events.summary: Applied Materials Inc (AMAT) shares dropped 4.3% to $461.67, yet the stock is still considered significantly overvalued with a GF Value™ of $238.94. Despite a strong GF Score™ of 85/100, driven by high profitability and growth, its valuation rank is 1/10, and insiders have sold $179.8 million worth of shares without any purchases. This suggests caution for investors due to the substantial premium over its intrinsic value.

events.title: Have Applied Materials Insiders Been Selling Stock?
events.summary: A Senior VP at Applied Materials recently sold US$3.6m worth of stock, reducing their holding by 15%. This follows a larger US$56m sale by the President over the last year, though both sales were at prices higher than the current stock price. Despite insider selling, the company's profitability and high insider ownership (0.3% of the company, valued at US$995m) suggest that management's interests may still be aligned with shareholders.

events.title: Van ECK Associates Corp Buys 8,922,854 Shares of Lam Research Corporation $LRCX
events.summary: Van ECK Associates Corp significantly increased its stake in Lam Research Corporation (LRCX) by 411.8%, acquiring an additional 8.92 million shares to hold a total of 11.09 million shares valued at approximately $4.81 billion. The semiconductor company recently exceeded earnings and revenue expectations, raised its quarterly dividend by 27%, and is undertaking a major investment in an AI semiconductor lab in Oregon, despite ongoing concerns about insider selling and U.S.-China trade risks. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating with an average price target of $357.31.

events.title: GTS Securities LLC Purchases 3,829 Shares of Lam Research Corporation $LRCX
events.summary: GTS Securities LLC increased its stake in Lam Research Corporation by 169.1% in the second quarter, acquiring an additional 3,829 shares to hold a total of 6,093 shares valued at approximately $2.64 million. The semiconductor company also reported strong quarterly earnings, with EPS of $1.82 and revenue up 30% year-over-year, leading to a 27% increase in its quarterly dividend. Despite favorable analyst ratings and significant institutional ownership, concerns about China exposure, tariffs, and insider selling temper investor sentiment.

events.title: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) Stock Forecast and Price Target 2026
events.summary: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) has a consensus "Moderate Buy" rating from 15 Wall Street analysts, with an average price target of $1,731.42, implying a 41.47% upside from its current price. The company recently reported strong financial results, driven by AI infrastructure demand and recovery in automotive and industrial sectors, but faces concerns regarding its high P/E ratio, recent stock decline, and insider selling. Despite these bear points, institutional investors are increasing their positions, and MPWR maintains a modest dividend yield.

events.title: Lam Research Corporation $LRCX Stake Increased by Proficio Capital Partners LLC
events.summary: Proficio Capital Partners LLC significantly increased its stake in Lam Research Corporation (LRCX) by 24.4% in Q2 2026, now holding 38,496 shares valued at $16.7 million. Lam Research has exceeded quarterly expectations with strong revenue growth and increased its dividend, leading to a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts. Despite some recent insider selling by directors, institutional investors own a substantial 84.61% of the company's stock.

events.title: Applied Materials price target raised to $695 from $675 at UBS
events.summary: UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri has increased the price target for Applied Materials (AMAT) shares from $675 to $695, while maintaining a Buy rating. This adjustment reflects continued confidence in the semiconductor equipment supplier's financial outlook. The news was first published by TheFly, a source for real-time financial news.

events.title: UBS Adjusts Applied Materials Price Target to $695 From $675, Maintains Buy Rating
events.summary: UBS has increased its price target for Applied Materials (AMAT) to $695 from $675, while reiterating a Buy rating on the stock. This adjustment reflects the analyst's updated outlook for the semiconductor equipment company. The article also provides recent news headlines related to Applied Materials, including insider share sales, new board appointments, and other analyst recommendations.

events.title: I Keep Buying Marvell Technology Because Its Type Historically Wins
events.summary: The author continues to invest in Marvell Technology due to its essential role as a "picks-and-shovels" provider in the AI infrastructure build-out, supplying custom silicon, optical DSPs, switches, and interconnect chips to hyperscalers. The company's data center revenue is rapidly growing, margins are expanding, and guidance continues to be raised, making it a cleaner and faster-growing AI play compared to alternatives like Broadcom and Applied Materials. Despite customer concentration risk, an expanded warrant deal with a hyperscaler validates Marvell's market position and future growth.

events.title: F5’s (FFIV) Commitment to Customer Excellence in Technology
events.summary: Hotchkis & Wiley Large Cap Fundamental Value Fund highlighted F5, Inc. (FFIV) as a top contributor in its Q2 2026 investor letter, praising the company's application networking and security software despite being "misunderstood" as a legacy IT hardware vendor. The fund noted F5's strong quarterly results and raised guidance, emphasizing its over 50% market share in traditional ADCs and attractive valuation. The letter also discussed the broader market, warning against speculative AI investments and favoring fundamentally sound businesses.

events.title: Micron shares fall 1.8% following Taiwan incentive pay report
events.summary: Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) shares dropped 1.8% in pre-market trading after a report indicated the company plans its highest incentive pay package for Taiwan employees amidst potential strike action from its labor union. The union is seeking a more transparent profit-sharing bonus structure. This development, coupled with broader pressure on technology stocks due to higher interest rates, contributed to the share price decline.

events.title: Entegris, Penguin Solutions, Teradyne, Applied Materials, and KLA Corporation Stocks Trade Down, What You Need To Know
events.summary: Several semiconductor manufacturing companies including Entegris, Penguin Solutions, Teradyne, Applied Materials, and KLA Corporation saw their stock prices fall. This downturn is attributed to surging crude oil prices and rising benchmark Treasury yields, which have reignited inflation concerns and increased corporate borrowing costs. The article suggests that such significant price drops could present good buying opportunities for high-quality stocks.

events.title: Palkhiwala Akash J. Appointed as Director at Applied Materials Inc (AMAT)
events.summary: Palkhiwala Akash J. has been officially appointed as a Director at Applied Materials Inc (AMAT), as confirmed by a recent insider position filing. This appointment signifies his corporate role and connection to the company, providing important information for investors. The filing identifies Applied Materials Inc /DE as the company and AMAT as its stock symbol.

events.title: Cramer's lightning round: KLA Corporation is 'a great company'
events.summary: Jim Cramer offers rapid-fire stock advice in his "lightning round," commenting on several companies including Applied Materials, Velo3D, KLA Corporation, and General Dynamics. He suggests buying Applied Materials on dips, advises waiting for better revenue growth for Velo3D, praises KLA Corporation but notes its high valuation, and prefers Lockheed Martin within the defense sector.

events.title: Entegris, Penguin Solutions, Teradyne, Applied Materials, and KLA Corporation Stocks Trade Down, What You Need To Know
events.summary: Several semiconductor-related stocks, including Entegris, Penguin Solutions, Teradyne, Applied Materials, and KLA Corporation, experienced declines after surging crude oil prices and rising Treasury yields sparked inflation concerns and increased corporate borrowing costs. The market reaction was attributed to the U.S. military striking Iranian targets, leading to higher oil prices and a climb in the 10-year Treasury yield, which negatively impacts the cost of capital and profit margins in the chip supply chain. Despite the current dip, some of these stocks, like Teradyne, have shown significant gains year-to-date.

events.title: Lightning Round: My favorite in the defense group is still Lockheed Martin, says Jim Cramer
events.summary: Jim Cramer, host of "Mad Money," reiterated his preference for Lockheed Martin within the defense sector. He also provided his views on other stocks, including Applied Materials, Velo3D, KLA Corp, and General Dynamics.

events.title: Teradyne Expands UltraFLEXplus Platform with Three New Instruments to Power AI Semiconductor Testing
events.summary: Teradyne has expanded its UltraFLEXplus testing platform with three new instruments: UltraPin5000-EM, UltraPort-PCIe6, and UltraVS64-HP. These tools are designed to efficiently test complex AI and data center semiconductors by addressing challenges like pattern-intensive chips, high-speed I/O, and high-current architectures. The expansion aims to future-proof semiconductor testing and enhance efficiency across all manufacturing phases.

events.title: Forthright Family Wealth Advisory LLC Increases Stock Position in NVIDIA Corporation $NVDA
events.summary: Forthright Family Wealth Advisory LLC significantly increased its stake in NVIDIA Corporation by 790.5% in the second quarter, now holding 2,627 shares valued at $526,000. Institutional investors collectively own 65.27% of NVIDIA, which recently reported strong quarterly revenue and earnings, exceeding analyst expectations. Despite a bullish outlook, the company faces potential risks from higher supply costs, infrastructure bottlenecks, and macroeconomic pressures on technology stocks.

events.title: S&P Futures Tick Higher as Oil Prices and Bond Yields Fall, U.S. ADP Jobs Report and Broadcom Earnings on Tap
events.summary: S&P 500 E-Mini futures are up after three days of losses, driven by a retreat in oil prices and bond yields despite intensifying U.S.-Iran conflict. Investors are anticipating the U.S. ADP employment report and quarterly results from Broadcom, as previous economic data indicated a healthy but slowing U.S. economy. Dell Technologies surged on strong Q2 results and an upbeat sales outlook, while other chip and AI-related stocks faced pressure from elevated bond yields.

events.title: Onto Innovation (ONTO) Unveiled Dragonfly G5 At SEMICON Taiwan 2026
events.summary: Onto Innovation showcased its new Dragonfly G5 system at SEMICON Taiwan 2026, targeting advanced node logic and memory applications to improve defect inspection and yield for semiconductor manufacturers. The company emphasized how its process control solutions address challenges in high-volume chip production for AI and data centers. Investors are advised to watch for order and backlog growth related to Dragonfly G5 and advanced packaging tools in upcoming reports.

events.title: Jim Cramer Says This Tech Stock Is Up 40% For The Year: It Is A ‘Great’ Company
events.summary: Jim Cramer highlighted KLA Corporation (NASDAQ: KLAC) as a "great" company with a 40% year-to-date gain, despite a high price-to-earnings multiple. He also discussed Applied Materials (NASDAQ: AMAT), Velo3D (NASDAQ: VELO), and General Dynamics (NYSE: GD), recommending Lockheed Martin (NYSE: LMT) as his top pick in the defense sector. The article also provides recent stock performances for these companies.

events.title: Lam Research (LRCX) Q3 2025 Earnings: Results, Market Reaction & History
events.summary: Lam Research reported strong Q3 2025 earnings, surpassing revenue and EPS estimates due to increased demand for deposition and etch equipment. The company saw a significant year-over-year revenue increase and provided an optimistic outlook for the June quarter, signaling continued growth despite tariff uncertainties. These results reflect strong performance across key geographies and expanding gross margins.

events.title: Applied Materials Just Dropped 14% in a Month. Sell Now, or Buy More?
events.summary: Applied Materials (AMAT) stock has dropped 14% in the past month despite reporting record revenue and raising guidance, while its peers have seen minimal declines. This selloff is attributed to profit-taking after a 178% surge over the past year, indicating that strong execution was already priced into the stock. Investors are now faced with deciding whether to sell or buy more, with the burden of proof resting on buyers until the next earnings report.

events.title: Applied Materials’ stock buybacks: History & investor impact explained
events.summary: Applied Materials, a leading manufacturer of semiconductor equipment, has a long history of stock buybacks dating back to 1996, totaling nearly $50 billion. The company's buyback activity, often exceeding its free cash flow, demonstrates an aggressive approach to returning value to shareholders, particularly in recent years amidst rising interest in AI. Despite a record stock high in June 2026, the company reduced repurchases in fiscal 2026.
